label.en: The cache moves on to another planet

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5083 distar.5052 (hidden loop) picks the next unscanned colony of a non-hostile country and sends the cache fleet there; carrier distar.5056 (events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5286) removes enigmatic_cache_in_orbit and, 1 day later, distar.5059 tells the planet's owner once (flag cache_has_changed_location).

label.zh: 货舱被召回，回到某国首都
label.en: The cache is called back to a country's capital

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5726 distar.5060 (hidden monthly): once every non-hostile country at peace has a scanned colony (or at least one human player's species colony has been scanned), a player country (flag enigmatic_caches_choice, preferring one not outclassed in technology) is chosen, global flag cache_returned is set and the fleet flies to its homeworld; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1807 on_fleet_auto_move_arrival → distar.5061 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5913) → distar.5062 (events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5942).

label.en: The cache is disabled by someone else (20 days later)

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2048 on_ship_disabled → distar.5053 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:5381): a player country researching ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING that is not the aggressor gets distar.5070 after 20 days; the cache respawns elsewhere, but if its own uplifting was running the cache is gone for good.

label.zh: 首都被攻陷时货舱在轨（10天后）
label.en: Capital invaded while the cache is in orbit (10 days later)

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:838 on_colony_attackers_win → distar.5077 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:6725): the country researching ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING is invaded on its capital while the cache fleet is in orbit; the project is aborted and distar.5078 follows after 10 days.

label.zh: 项目完成的结果（取决于货舱是否损坏）
label.en: Project result (depends on whether the cache broke)

note.zh: 权重 60/20/100：未损坏（没有 enigmatic_cache_broken）时 5074 为0，即 5068:5063 = 75%:25%；损坏时 5063 为0，5068 与 5074 为 37.5%:62.5%，而种族本就聪明/学习快（intelligent、quick_learners）时 5068 也为0，全部是 5074。损坏标志由 distar.5071“警报”设置，由 distar.5073（修复完成）或 distar.5069（中止）清除（common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING on_success）。编译树显示的 33/11/56% 是以上情况的平均值，并不真实。
note.en: Weights 60/20/100: while the cache is intact (no enigmatic_cache_broken) 5074 is 0, so 5068:5063 = 75%:25%; once broken 5063 is 0 and 5068:5074 = 37.5%:62.5%, and for an already intelligent / quick-learning species 5068 is 0 too, leaving only 5074. The broken flag is set by distar.5071 "Alert" and cleared by distar.5073 (repair complete) or distar.5069 (aborted) (ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING on_success in common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt). The 33/11/56% shown by the compiled tree is an average of these cases and is not real.

note.zh: 提升成功但伴随悲伤修正（enigmatic_sadness，3600天）。
note.en: The uplift works but with a sadness modifier (enigmatic_sadness, 3600 days).

note.zh: 货舱损坏后的结果：较差的智力特质与疯狂修正。
note.en: The result after the cache broke: a poorer intelligence trait and a madness modifier.

note.zh: 货舱被删除并留下恐怖生物的残影。
note.en: The cache fleet is deleted and leaves a horror-spawn ambient object.

notes.zh: 选项会设置 lcluster_clue_desc_1 并调用 pop_lcluster_event，即有机会产生 L-星团线索（参见“L-星团”故事 event-distar-13080）。
notes.en: The option sets lcluster_clue_desc_1 and calls pop_lcluster_event, so it can yield an L-Cluster clue (see the L-Cluster story event-distar-13080).

scope.zh: 异常定义（生成条件、等级、次数限制）与全部结果事件已对照源文件核对。
scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.

uncertain: The exact 5060 selection rule (which player country is chosen, 'not outclassed in technology') was read but its in-game effect on the chosen country was not simulated.
The text of the four dialogue options in distar.5064/5072 was not read line by line; only the options and the project/abort effects were checked.
